blocks.orig: While doing a safari in Mikumi National Park, the Vuma Hills Tented Camp is a lovely choice for your overnight. This tented camp has a beautiful view of the Mkata Plains of the national park. All tents are comfortably furnished and have ensuite bathrooms. There is also a covered veranda at each tent from where you can enjoy the surroundings – including the bush babies who might pay a visit! In the evening you can relax at the campfire and in the cosy bar and dining area. And if you are looking to cool down after safari, a swimming pool is at your disposal.
blocks.html: If you are on safari in Mikumi National Park, the Vuma Hills Tented Camp makes a lovely place to spend the night. The camp looks out beautifully over the park's Mkata Plains. Every tent is comfortably furnished and has an ensuite bathroom, plus a covered veranda where you can take in the surroundings – and perhaps the bush babies that drop by! In the evening you can unwind by the campfire or in the cosy bar and dining area. Want to cool off after your game drive? There is a swimming pool for you to use.
